MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    
    visited = [0] * p
    ans = 1
    
    if k == 1:
        ans = 0
    else:
        for i in range(p):
            if not visited[i]:
                cur = i
                while not visited[cur]:
                    visited[cur] = 1
                    cur = (k * cur) % p
                ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
